# Adobe for Creativity

Skills that teach agents to work with Adobe for Creativity. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [adobe/skills](https://github.com/adobe/skills), at commit `0f487c9`.

Brings together Adobe Creative Cloud tools for images, vectors, design, and video.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Adobe for Creativity**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Adobe for Creativity**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install adobe-for-creativity@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

15 skills: `adobe`, `adobe-anydocx`, `adobe-anyexcel`, `adobe-anypdf`, `adobe-anypptx`, `adobe-batch-edit-photos`, `adobe-create-pdfs-from-data`, `adobe-create-social-variations`, `adobe-design-from-template`, `adobe-design-to-pdf`, `adobe-document-review`, `adobe-edit-quick-cut`, `adobe-fonts`, `adobe-resize-photos-and-videos`, `adobe-retouch-portraits`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `ADOBE_API_KEY`. This plugin does not store them.

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/adobe/skills
